project_type: C11 programming language implementation (Eka) with VM, compiler, HTTP server, and 27 builtins
build_system: CMake with pkg-config dependencies. Build dir: /projects/sandbox/ek/build
test_framework: Custom C test harness in tests/ (no framework, just assert-style macros: TEST/PASS/FAIL/CHECK)
verification_instructions: 1. Build: cd build && make -j$(nproc). 2. Test: ctest --output-on-failure. 3. All 8 tests must pass.
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed. Build directory already configured at /projects/sandbox/ek/build. Just run make in that directory. PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/local/lib64/pkgconfig must be set for cmake to find libcmark.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET. All deps installed (libuv-devel from dnf, cmark from source at /usr/local). Build already works.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. Code follows existing patterns: builtins are C functions registered in eka_builtins_register(). Tests use custom TEST/PASS/FAIL/CHECK macros.
key_patterns: Builtins: static eka_value_t name(eka_vm_t *vm, void *ctx, int argc, eka_value_t *args). Registered as maps of native functions via map_set_cstr + make_native. Tests call builtins directly via call_global/call_method helpers. Each test function is called from main().
directory_structure: src/ (main code: builtins/, cli/, client/, compiler/, core/, fmt/, lexer/, parser/, runtime/), tests/ (8 test files), doc/ (10 docs), vendor/ (yyjson)
